_README: Curated ComfyUI node/input renames, applied to the finished graph just before submission by
comfy_node_aliases.apply_node_aliases(). Builders keep naming the identity they were grounded
on; this map translates to whatever the live core calls it.
Every rewrite is validated against the live /object_info: a class rename is only taken when the
replacement genuinely exists, and only when the OLD name is genuinely gone. An input rename is
only taken when the target input is genuinely in that class's schema. So a stale entry here is
ONLY add entries you have confirmed -- ideally by a render, not just a successful submit. An
incorrect rename converts a loud 400 into a silent wrong render, which is far more expensive.
Auto-detected candidates from the contract diff belong in a report, not in this file, until a
nodes.<OldClass>.replaced_by : string or ordered list; first one present in the live core wins
nodes.<OldClass>.inputs      : {old_input: new_input} applied after the class rename
nodes.<OldClass>.note        : why, and what confirmed it
inputs.<Class>               : {old_input: new_input} for a class that kept its name
Empty is the correct state today: the v0.33.1 pre-screen found no core node we depend on
